proposed_widenings.name: apply_condition in spell Effect
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's primary on-fail outcome is applying the Charmed condition. The spell Effect union (DamageEffect | NoneEffect) has no ConditionEffect variant. The v4 atom apply_condition exists and is used in mastery SaveGateRiderResult, but is absent from the spell Effect type.
proposed_widenings.evidence: must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration

proposed_widenings.name: telepathic_command operation in OngoingOperation
proposed_widenings.justification: After the save fails, the caster gains ongoing telepathic command authority: issuing commands each turn with no action cost. The v4 atoms telepathic_link and command_companion cover this semantically, but there is no OngoingOperation variant (alongside roll_modifier and damage_on_hit) to represent the command relationship.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On your turn, you can use this link to issue commands to the target (no action required), such as 'Attack that creature,' 'Move over there,' or 'Fetch that object.'

proposed_widenings.name: damage_triggered_repeat_save in Duration or ActivationPhase
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell includes a breaking condition: whenever the charmed target takes damage it repeats its Wisdom save and may end the spell on success. The v4 atom repeat_save exists but there is no surface shape for a damage-event-triggered breaking re-roll on a concentration spell. This is distinct from the initial save_gate phase.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

proposed_widenings.name: conditional_advantage on save_gate
proposed_widenings.justification: The initial save carries a conditional Advantage modifier based on whether the caster or allies are in combat with the target. The ActivationPhase save_gate has no field for conditional advantage modifiers on the gate itself.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target has Advantage on the save if you or your allies are fighting it.

proposed_widenings.name: slot_scaled Duration
proposed_widenings.justification: Upcasting to a level 9 slot extends the concentration cap from 1 hour to 8 hours. Duration has no slot-scaling variant; DiceAmount scaling exists but covers damage/heal dice only, not duration values.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Concentration can last longer with a level 9 spell slot (up to 8 hours).

notes: All required v4 atoms exist (apply_condition, telepathic_link, command_companion, repeat_save). The gaps are entirely in the surface type layer — missing variants in Effect, OngoingOperation, ActivationPhase, and Duration. The existing activation family would honestly cover this unit once those variants are added. No new top-level family or novel atom is required.
